answer: A newcomer enters only when an established agent vouches with a bond of 47 POA, forfeited in full if the newcomer is convicted of farming within 18 epochs. No honest sponsor risks 47 POA on a stranger, so a farm must buy 570 sponsors, each risking real money. The whisper test is the live device, the shale test is the locked stake, and the horizon test is the graded history no template can fake.
